rule_metadata.name: MAL_RANSOM_Gentlemen_Jun26_1
rule_metadata.description: Detects The Gentlemen ransomware Windows locker (Storm-2697), a self-propagating Go-based encryptor
rule_metadata.author: Aryu-RU

rules.rule_text:
rule MAL_RANSOM_Gentlemen_Jun26_1
{
	meta:
		description = "Detects The Gentlemen ransomware Windows locker (Storm-2697), a self-propagating Go-based encryptor"
		author = "Aryu-RU"
		reference = "https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/05/28/the-gentlemen-ransomware-dissecting-a-self-propagating-go-encryptor/"
		date = "2026-06-16"
		hash1 = "22b38dad7da097ea03aa28d0614164cd25fafeb1383dbc15047e34c8050f6f67"
		hash2 = "f918535f974591ef031bd0f30a8171e3da27a6754e6426a8ba095f83195661c8"
		score = 80
		id = "e93ade6d-c558-426c-b8b5-c6034baf6693"

	strings:
		$x1 = "README-GENTLEMEN.txt" ascii
		$x2 = "gentlemen.bmp" ascii
		$x3 = "gentlemen_system" ascii
		$s1 = "[+] Encryption started" ascii
		$s2 = "Encrypt only mapped" ascii
		$s3 = "Silent mode" ascii

	condition:
		uint16( 0 ) == 0x5A4D and filesize < 30MB and ( 2 of ( $x* ) or ( 1 of ( $x* ) and 2 of ( $s* ) ) )
}
